positive_snippets:
We recently hosted my sister’s wedding at this venue, and the experience was truly excellent. The food was outstanding, and the decor was beautifully done — everything was managed with great taste and attention to detail.

The stay and rooms were very comfortable and well maintained. The entire staff, including housekeeping and support teams, were extremely helpful, polite, and always available whenever needed.

Special mention to the running tea and coffee counters, snacks, and the Maggi counter — hot food was served consistently, which was greatly appreciated by guests.

Chanderbhushan ji was always present and ready to help at every step, making things very smooth for us. Excellent overall management by Dinesh Gupta ji across all areas — his coordination and leadership truly stood out.

Overall, a wonderful experience and a perfect venue for a memorable wedding. Highly recommended!

Attended a wedding here 4 weeks ago. Stayed for 4 days in the hotel. Staff is very courteous and goes out if the way to help you and they try to make the stay as comfortable as possible. It is not a regular hotel but an event venue with rooms for the attendees to stay.
All the events were very well managed and the food preparations were excellent.
The events for marriage were arranged both indoors and outdoors. The decor and service was wonderful. Everything was always ready on time.
negative_snippets:
I had my engagement ceremony at this hotel, and it turned out to be one of the worst experiences I have ever had. I would strongly not recommend this venue to anyone planning an important event.

They took all the payment in advance and talk nicely but once they get all payment they don’t even listen your complaints.

From the beginning, the manager was extremely rude and unprofessional. Instead of helping us during such an important occasion, the management showed no sense of responsibility or hospitality. Whenever we tried to discuss arrangements or ask for assistance, the response was dismissive and disrespectful.

The staff was also very uncooperative. Basic requests during the function were either ignored or handled very poorly. There was a clear lack of coordination and professionalism, which created unnecessary stress for us and our guests on what was supposed to be a joyful day.

An engagement ceremony is a once-in-a-lifetime moment, and we trusted this hotel to manage it properly. Unfortunately, their poor management, rude behavior, and unhelpful staff completely ruined the experience.

I would strongly advise others to avoid booking this venue for any event, especially important celebrations like engagements, weddings, or family functions. There are many other places that value their customers and provide far better service.
